settings.siteTitle: BIOCORE — Biocore Research LLP Translational Deep-Science Platform
settings.siteDescription: Biocore Research LLP (BIOCORE) is a translational deep-science company connecting biological science, advanced engineering, scientific instrumentation, testing & certification, sustainable technology, and commercialization.

hero.headline: BRIDGING BIOLOGICAL SCIENCE &
hero.subtitle: Biocore Research LLP connects laboratory research, scientific instrumentation, testing & certification infrastructure, sustainable technology, and commercialization.

about.title: Translating biological science and precision engineering into industrial technologies, testing infrastructure, and commercial impact.
about.description: Biocore Research LLP (operating publicly as BIOCORE) is a translational deep-science company structured to bridge molecular biology with hardware-level engineering, scientific instrumentation, testing & certification, sustainable technology, and commercialization.
about.secondaryDescription: Connecting biological discovery, hardware engineering, laboratory validation, industry, and societal needs.

features.title: BIOCORE CAPABILITY AREAS
features.subtitle: Comprehensive business scope connecting biological sciences, precision hardware engineering, laboratory testing, sustainable technology, and technology transfer.

items.title: Life Sciences & Biotechnology
items.description: Research, development, formulation, and analysis in biopharmaceuticals, biotechnology, agrobiogenics, tissue culture, microbiology, and molecular biology.

items.title: Bioengineering & Advanced Electronics
items.description: Design, engineering, and production of microchips, biosensors, bioelectronics, embedded electronic systems, and precision analytical hardware.

items.title: Scientific Instrumentation
items.description: Development and manufacturing support for scientific laboratory instruments, optical-electronic measurement systems, and bio-analytical apparatus.

items.title: Laboratory Testing & Analytical Services
items.description: Analytical laboratory testing, quality control, certification, and standard validation for food, water, agricultural products, environmental samples, and pharmaceuticals.

items.title: Sustainable & Environmental Technology
items.description: Zero-waste and zero-carbon processing systems, renewable biofuels, eco-friendly agrochemicals, biofertilizers, and biological environmental remediation.

items.title: Consultancy, Training & Tech Transfer
items.description: Technical consultancy, project advisory, workforce training, technology transfer, defence research support, and industrial innovation implementation.

items.title: Research & Institutional Collaboration
items.description: Joint research initiatives, strategic partnerships, and technical collaboration with national/international institutions, industries, and government bodies.

stats.subtitle: A structured approach to translational science, laboratory testing, and technological commercialization.
